evidence.title: Pappas leads Sununu by 7 points in New Hampshire Senate race: Poll

occurrences.checkable_against: New Hampshire governor biographies and family relationship records
occurrences.quote_span: He is related to former New Hampshire Govs. John H. Sununu and Chris Sununu.

occurrences.subject: AARP/NHIP poll of New Hampshire Senate race

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. House member history and Problem Solvers Caucus membership records

occurrences.subject: AARP/NHIP poll of New Hampshire Senate race

occurrences.checkable_against: New Hampshire U.S. Senate election results and gubernatorial election results

occurrences.checkable_against: Christina FitzPatrick statement on the AARP New Hampshire Senate poll

occurrences.subject: AARP/NHIP poll of New Hampshire Senate race

occurrences.checkable_against: Christina FitzPatrick statement on the AARP New Hampshire Senate poll
occurrences.quote_span: “With affordability a top concern for New Hampshire residents this year, candidates should tell voters how they will protect and strengthen Social Security and ensure that everyone is able to age with dignity and purpose,” FitzPatrick said in a statement.

occurrences.subject: AARP/NHIP poll of New Hampshire Senate race

occurrences.speaker: NHIP
occurrences.subject: AARP/NHIP poll of New Hampshire Senate race
